title: Exploring Agentic AI: Trust boundaries and the risks of safe models being exploited by fraudsters
summary: Faced with increasing urgency, boards in banking and finance are turning to generative AI for productivity boosts. However, this technology brings forth governance dilemmas that cannot be ignored. Current safety protocols focus mainly on undesirable outputs, neglecting the actions and decisions of the AI agents themselves. This calls for a revised risk analysis approach, with stringent governance protocols necessary for safely navigating the introduction of agentic AI into regulated environments.
